{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of customers in the cleaned data
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_age)"}
